title: "About"

## Background 
Before joining the MDS program, I studied at BCIT, where I completed a Diploma in International Trade and Transportation, a Bachelor of Business Administration in Business Intelligence and Value Management, and a Graduate Certificate in Business Analytics. I also hold the Certified Customs Specialist (CCS) designation from the Canadian Society of Customs Brokers (CSCB).

I have over twenty years of professional experience working with data-driven forecasting, reporting, and business systems across international trade, customs, freight forwarding, and global supply chain operations. My work involved close collaboration with IT teams and data engineers, supporting EDI, ERP and CRM implementations, and translating complex data into actionable insights for senior leadership.


## Why data science 
My interest in data science grew naturally from years of working closely with data, forecasting, and business systems across multiple industries, where I experienced firsthand the impact of data-driven decision-making. To prepare for this transition, I completed programming courses and enrolled in BCIT’s Graduate Certificate in Business Analytics to strengthen my foundation in statistics, probability, and applied analytics. I am drawn to the UBC MDS program to deepen my knowledge of data science and emerging technologies, and to further develop the technical skills needed to succeed in this rapidly evolving field.


## Outside of data science
Outside of studying, I enjoy keeping things simple, taking care of my indoor plants, doing some house cleaning, and catching up on as much sleep as possible on the weekends. My favourite hobbies can probably be summarized as sleep, eat, and chill! I also enjoy different activities with the seasons : travelling in the spring, hiking in the summer, relaxing in hot springs in the fall, and snowboarding in the winter.
